seasonal_concentration.note: Apr-May show systematic large negative bias distinct from Jun-Sep

bias_reversal_h9_12_to_h14_15.conclusion: aggregate reversal is real but NOT a robust per-day mechanism; driven by different subsets of days, not consistent sign-flipping

phase3_h9_h12_forensics.verdict: genuine error mode, concentrated in shoulder-season (Apr-May) cloud-transition/high-volatility conditions; not a simple uniform bias correction opportunity

phase4_model_by_model.best_model_per_horizon: an HGB variant wins every horizon except H1 (TimesFM) and H23-H24 (Dynamic Ensemble Hybrid, marginal)
phase4_model_by_model.h9_h12_leader: HGB 37-feature (or near-twin) at every horizon; next best structurally distinct model (Dynamic Ensemble Hybrid) is 19% worse at H12, foundation models 60-200% worse
phase4_model_by_model.note_evaluation_alignment: all figures computed on the same 173 ODD dates and shared ground truth for every model, correcting the origin-count mismatch found in audit

phase5_complementarity.conclusion: no model pair shows genuinely complementary (anti-correlated or near-zero-correlated) errors; all alternative models are both weaker overall AND relatively worse (not better) during HGB's hardest events; hard events are hard for every model, not specifically for HGB
phase5_complementarity.ensemble_recommendation: NOT JUSTIFIED with the current model inventory; do not proceed to weighted/horizon-specific ensembling of these specific models without new evidence of genuine error diversity

next_phase: PHASE 7 candidate solution design, informed by: (a) H9-H12 shoulder-season/high-volatility error mode from Phase 3, (b) no multi-model ensembling opportunity from Phase 5 -> favor single-model residual/regime-aware approaches over model blending
